json-patch.name: JSON Patch Applier
json-patch.description: Apply RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations locally. Add, remove, replace, move, copy and test JSON values without losing number precision.

meta.title: JSON Patch Applier
meta.description: Apply RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations locally. Add, remove, replace, move, copy and test JSON values without losing number precision.
meta.keywords: JSON Patch, RFC 6902, apply patch, JSON operations, JSON Pointer

jsonPatch.emptyResult: Enter target JSON and a patch array, or load the example.
jsonPatch.hint: Each input: 500,000 UTF-16 units; nesting: 64 levels; up to 200 operations. Paths: up to 4,096 units. Result budget: 2,000,000 units, plus a total processing limit.
jsonPatch.rules: Operations run in order. Paths use / with ~1 for slash and ~0 for tilde; empty paths select the root. Array add inserts, and /- appends. A failed operation stops the patch; no partial result is shown.
jsonPatch.rootRule: add / replace / test require value, including null. move / copy require from. Parents must exist; remove / replace require an existing value. Root removal must be followed by root add to produce JSON. URI fragments are not accepted.
jsonPatch.duplicateKey: Duplicate object keys are not allowed.
jsonPatch.invalidPatch: The patch must be a JSON array of operation objects.
jsonPatch.invalidOperation: Use add, remove, replace, move, copy or test with the required members.
jsonPatch.invalidPointer: Use an empty path or /-separated JSON Pointer, valid ~0/~1 escapes, and at most 4,096 units.
jsonPatch.missingPath: The referenced value or its parent does not exist.
jsonPatch.invalidIndex: Invalid array index: use 0 or a positive integer without leading zeros; - is only for add destinations.
jsonPatch.moveChild: A value cannot be moved into one of its own descendants.
jsonPatch.testFailed: The test value does not match; the patch was stopped.
jsonPatch.noDocument: Root removal left no JSON document. Add a new root with an empty path.
jsonPatch.outputLimit: The result exceeds the 2,000,000-unit formatting budget.
jsonPatch.workLimit: Total processing limit reached. Use fewer operations or smaller values.
